categories.main_business_segments: Shandong Hualu Hengsheng Chemical Co., Ltd. operates primarily in chemical manufacturing with key segments including new energy and new materials related products, fertilizers, organic amines, acetic acid and derivatives, and other chemical products. The company also engages in power generation, heat supply, and chemical technology consulting services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes clean coal gasification technology as a core platform, enabling flexible multi-product integrated production. Key production processes include benzene oxime rearrangement for caprolactam, cyclohexane and cyclohexene methods for adipic acid, propylene carbonylation for octanol, ethylene glycol co-production for dimethyl carbonate, and proprietary high-efficiency, low-energy urea synthesis technology. The company emphasizes continuous technological innovation, system optimization, energy saving, and emission reduction.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves diverse downstream industries including textiles, automotive, industrial manufacturing, agriculture, pharmaceuticals, electronics, and packaging. Fertilizer products primarily target agricultural production and industrial processing markets. New energy and new materials products cater to sectors such as lithium battery electrolytes, engineering plastics, and polyurethane. The company’s products are sold domestically across multiple provinces and exported internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in China, with headquarters and main production bases in Dezhou and Jingzhou. Domestic sales dominate, with approximately 95% of revenue from within China and the remainder from overseas markets. The company also exports products to various countries, maintaining a global presence in select product lines.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream chemical manufacturing segment, producing intermediate and final chemical products. It integrates upstream raw material processing (e.g., coal gasification) with downstream product manufacturing and sales, maintaining a multi-product chain with some vertical integration including power and heat supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include high-quality development, cost leadership, and market resilience. The company focuses on extending and upgrading its industrial chain, investing in new energy and new materials projects, and enhancing production efficiency. R&D efforts emphasize clean coal gasification, green low-carbon technologies, and product innovation, supported by collaborations with academic and research institutions. The company also pursues digital transformation and precision investment to sustain competitive advantage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of chemical products including fertilizers, organic amines, acetic acid derivatives, and new energy materials. Sales are conducted via direct sales and contracts, with pricing influenced by market supply-demand dynamics and cost factors. The company also earns income from power generation and heat supply services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in several product markets, such as being the largest domestic producer of DMF and a top player in caprolactam and adipic acid markets. It competes with other large chemical manufacturers in China’s coal chemical and fertilizer industries. The company emphasizes cost advantages, technological innovation, and product quality to maintain its competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 27.26 billion, a 9.87% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.58 billion, down 43.14%. Total assets grew 25.84% to RMB 44.05 billion, and net assets increased 7.31% to RMB 28.89 billion. The company has a stable financial scale with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and technology upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through integrated clean coal gasification technology enabling efficient multi-product production, strong cost control, and flexible product structure adjustment. It offers high-quality, stable products with a focus on green, low-carbon development and safety. Its extensive R&D capabilities and strategic investments in new energy and materials position it as a technology-driven leader with robust market recognition and brand strength.
